# `auth_setup_token`

One-time link to set or reset a password (IAM-01 account recovery, invitation acceptance). Only the newest per user and tenant is usable.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | infrastructure |
| Tenant scope | Not tenant scoped |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `authentication`: Credentials, MFA secrets and sessions: kept while the account exists; sessions and challenges purged after expiry plus a security review window. Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /v1/members/{id}/access-link |
| Write path | auth_issue_setup_token() from a tenant administrator; redeemed by AuthService. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0005_auth (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (id)
- unique token_hash
- FK (tenant_id, membership_id) -> membership
- purpose in (initial-password, password-reset)
- expires_at > created_at
- cannot be issued by the user for themself
